form.hostKeyHint: The first time, you will be shown the server's key fingerprint to confirm. A different key later is refused.

lint.selectStarLarge: SELECT * reads every column of {{table}}, about {{formatted}} rows. List the columns you need or add a LIMIT.
lint.selectNoLimit: No LIMIT: this query may return every row. On production, add a LIMIT.

unknown.headline: The statement could not run
unknown.recovery: Read the technical detail below, or ask the agent to explain it.

23502.headline: A required column has no value
23502.recovery: Provide a value for the column.

23503.headline: The row refers to, or is referred to by, another row
23503.recovery: Add or remove the related row first.

23505.headline: A row with the same unique value already exists
23505.recovery: Change the value, or update the existing row instead.

40001.headline: The database could not finish the transaction

42501.headline: This user is not allowed to do that
42501.recovery: Use a role with the right privileges, or ask whoever runs the server.

42601.headline: The statement has a syntax error
42601.recovery: Check the spelling near the position shown under Technical detail, or ask the agent to fix it.

42703.headline: A column in the statement does not exist
42703.recovery: Open the table in the tree to see its columns.

42883.headline: The function or operator does not exist for these types
42883.recovery: Cast the values to the types the function expects.

53300.headline: The server has no free connections
53300.recovery: Close other sessions or wait a moment.

57014.headline: The statement was cancelled or took too long
57014.recovery: Narrow it with a WHERE clause or a smaller limit, or raise the statement timeout on the connection.

42P01.headline: A table or view in the statement does not exist
42P01.recovery: Check the name and schema in the tree on the left.

22P02.headline: A value is not valid for its type
22P02.recovery: Check the format of the value, for example a number or a date.

40P01.headline: Two transactions waited for each other

timeout.headline: The statement took too long
timeout.recovery: Narrow it, or raise the statement timeout on the connection.

cancelled.headline: The statement was cancelled
cancelled.recovery: Run it again when you are ready.

read-only.headline: This connection is read-only
read-only.recovery: Turn read-only off in the connection settings to change data.

connect.headline: The connection to the database failed
connect.recovery: Check that the server is running and that the host, port and credentials are right.

tunnel.headline: The SSH tunnel could not be opened
tunnel.recovery: Check the SSH host, user and key in the connection settings.
